solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Mum's vehicle key — item found in handbag?

parts.note: Mum is MA, and the possessive keeps the S
a car is a vehicle
A is a musical key

explanation.surface: A mother's car key turns up among the things she keeps in her handbag.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as an example: this eye make-up is one thing commonly carried in a handbag.
explanation.definitionFit: Eye make-up is a typical cosmetic carried in a woman's bag, so it is an example of such an item.

clue.text: Glorious thing seeing kid in tree

indicators.note: in puts the kidding inside the tree

parts.note: may is the hawthorn tree
to kid is to joke, or jest

explanation.surface: Something splendid: a young goat up a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kid' looks like a child or goat, but it is the verb meaning to tease.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandeur or splendour, as in the majesty of the mountains, is a glorious quality.

clue.text: Nothing supporting meeting, one's very much exposed to criticism

definitions.text: one's very much exposed to criticism

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means placed below the meeting

parts.note: a sitting is a session or meeting of a body
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket

explanation.surface: Backing a meeting that produced nothing leaves you exposed to criticism.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck is a batsman's score of zero in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: An easy target with no defence, like a bird resting on water, is very exposed to attack.

clue.text: In departing, train say skidding off the rails

indicators.note: departing says the letters of in leave the fodder
skidding throws the remaining letters into disorder

parts.note: the letters of train say, without those of in, are the pool

explanation.surface: A train skids off its rails on its way out, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: Take IN out of TRAINSAY ('In departing') and 'skidding' rearranges TRASAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Going wrong or off course, as a plan goes off the rails, is going wayward.

clue.text: Quite obtuse, all jerks on telly, ultimately

indicators.note: jerks means the letters are jolted into a new order
ultimately takes the last letter of telly

explanation.surface: Every idiot on television is pretty dim, in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jerks' looks like fools on TV but it is the anagram signal for OBTUSE ALL; 'telly' is British for television.
explanation.definitionFit: Quite in its sense of completely or totally, as in quite right, matches this adverb.

clue.text: Rest a load and lean back

indicators.note: back says the pieces for a load and lean are read from right to left

parts.note: pots, as in pots of money, means a load or lots
to tip is to lean or tilt

explanation.surface: Someone told to rest, set down their burden and lean back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns POTS + TIP into the answer; it looks like part of 'lean back' but is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: In motor racing a stop in the pits is a brief halt, and by extension any short break on a journey.

clue.text: Attempt to sell bathroom equipment

definitions.meaning: to promote a product by mentioning it publicly
a stopper for a bath or basin drain

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a publicity mention and a stopper that seals a bath drain.

clue.text: Runner turned on a father protecting wife after time

indicators.note: after says the a-father group follows time
protecting means the father wraps around the wife

parts.note: pater is Latin and old British slang for father

explanation.surface: An athlete turns on a father who is shielding his wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runner' looks like an athlete but it is something that runs from a faucet when it is opened.
explanation.definitionFit: Water from the mains flows when you open the faucet, so it runs when turned on.

clue.text: Ram position from below

indicators.note: in a down clue, from below means reading the word upwards

parts.note: to put is to position or place

explanation.surface: A ram's place seen from underneath.
explanation.definitionFit: A dialect and farming word for a male sheep.

clue.text: Paint light under socket

indicators.note: in a down clue, under means placed below the socket

parts.note: a port is a socket for plugging in a cable
a ray is a beam of light

explanation.surface: Painting with a lamp below an electric socket.
explanation.definitionFit: To depict someone, as a painter or writer does, is to paint them.

clue.text: Very dark stream

definitions.meaning: as an adjective, deep glossy black like the mineral
a narrow forceful spurt of liquid or gas

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a shade of intense black and a narrow gush of water from a nozzle.

clue.text: Matter ending on lap in spill — absorbed with this?

indicators.note: in places the matter-plus-ending group within the word for spill

parts.note: a spill is a thin strip of wood or paper for lighting, a taper

indicators.note: on means the ending of lap follows straight after the matter

parts.note: an issue is a matter for discussion

indicators.note: ending picks the final letter of lap

explanation.surface: Something spilt in your lap, and the question of what to mop it up with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spill' looks like the accident, but it is a thin lighting strip; 'in' puts the matter and lap's last letter inside that strip.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin soft paper is what you would dab a spill with, so the clue's question points to the absorbent sheet.

clue.text: Fitting uniform, it's in black

indicators.note: in, after the 's of it's (is), puts the pieces inside the word for black

parts.note: sable is a heraldic and poetic word for black
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet
it is taken as written; the 's (is) is a link

explanation.surface: A uniform fits well if it is black.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fitting is appropriate or right for the occasion, an exact synonym.

clue.text: Possible sandwich filling for each container of sandwiches, say?

parts.note: ham is a common sandwich filling
per means for each, as in per person

explanation.surface: Musing on what goes inside a sandwich, and what the sandwiches go in.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is by example: a picnic basket holds sandwiches among other things, hence 'say?'.
explanation.definitionFit: A wicker basket with a lid, packed for picnics, carries food such as sandwiches.

clue.text: As nurses run, going this way and that?

definitions.text: As nurses run, going this way and that?

parts.words: As nurses run, going this way and that?
parts.note: the phrase nurses run reads the same backwards as forwards

explanation.surface: Busy nurses rushing back and forth along a ward.
explanation.walkthrough: Spell 'nurses run' backwards and you get it again, so it reads the same both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: A word or phrase reading identically in either direction, like level, has this quality.

clue.text: European film about cool stuff mostly, one likely to be controversial

parts.note: a Pole is a European from Poland

indicators.note: about puts the film around the trimmed cool stuff

parts.note: a mist is a thin film, as on glass

indicators.note: mostly says the last letter of cool stuff is dropped

parts.note: ice is cool stuff

explanation.surface: A European film that is mostly about ice provokes argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' looks like a movie but it is a thin layer, MIST.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer who argues fiercely in public disputes is likely to stir controversy.

clue.text: Stuff served with culture hasn't hurt, a relaxing discipline

indicators.note: hasn't says the following word is missing from the stuff

parts.note: yoghurt is made with a bacterial culture
taken as written

explanation.surface: A food or a relaxation practice that does no harm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'culture' looks like the arts, but it is the bacterial starter in yoghurt.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice of stretching, breathing and meditation, often taken up to unwind and calm the body.

clue.text: Skater requiring ploy to tamper with scoring method, of course?

indicators.note: to tamper with something is to interfere with and disturb it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A skater's trick used to rig the way points are counted.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'course' is a golf course: SKATER + PLOY rearranged gives the golf format counted by total shots.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf, this format scores by the total number of shots taken over the round, rather than holes won.

clue.text: Crooked spire, and twisted

indicators.note: crooked means bent out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A church spire that is crooked and twisted.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrenched ankle has been twisted, injuring the ligaments.

clue.text: Two bullets, one killing pest?

definitions.meaning: a slug and a pellet are both kinds of bullet, so the two words side by side
a small poison bait scattered in gardens to kill slimy pests

explanation.surface: Two shots fired, one of which kills a nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a pair of words each meaning a bullet; the second half is the garden poison bait.
explanation.definitionFit: Gardeners scatter little poisoned pellets to kill slugs, a molluscicide bait.

clue.text: Cocktail Mark consumes something fishy

indicators.note: consumes means the mark swallows the fish

parts.note: a scar is a mark on the skin
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A man called Mark drinks a cocktail with a suspicious ingredient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like a name, but it is a blemish, SCAR; 'something fishy' is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: A mixed drink of brandy, orange liqueur and lemon juice is a classic cocktail.

clue.text: Distinguish why, occasionally, North Korea's leaders looking to the West

indicators.note: in an across clue, looking west means reading right to left
leaders takes the first letter of each of why, occasionally, North and Korea's

explanation.surface: Asking why North Korea's rulers sometimes turn towards the West.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders' applies to all four words, not just North Korea's: W, O, N, K, read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To tell one thing from another is to recognise it, as in telling right from wrong.

clue.text: Coax husband at last into circle with relative at the end

indicators.note: into puts the husband's final letter inside the circle

parts.note: a wheel is a circle

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of husband
at the end picks the final letter of relative

explanation.surface: Persuading a husband finally to join a family circle with relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: To coax is to persuade by flattery or sweet talk, an exact synonym.

clue.text: Snare hasn't closed — you can say that again!

indicators.note: hasn't closed means the final letter of the snare is missing

parts.note: a mantrap is a snare for catching trespassers

explanation.surface: A trap that failed to spring shut prompts a hearty agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a playful gloss: a sacred chant or slogan is something said again and again.
explanation.definitionFit: A word or phrase repeated in meditation, or a slogan repeated often, is said over and over.

clue.text: Order drinks regularly, tasteless stuff

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of drinks, starting with the first

parts.note: tat is cheap, tasteless goods

explanation.surface: Ordering drinks often, and only nasty ones.
explanation.definitionFit: A decree imposed by an authority without consent is a command, so an order.

clue.text: New ideas about horse almost conflict

indicators.note: about puts the new ideas around the trimmed horse
new means the letters of ideas take a fresh arrangement
almost says the last letter of the horse is dropped

parts.note: a grey is a horse of that colour

explanation.surface: Fresh ideas on horses nearly cause a clash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' shuffles the clue word into DISAE; 'almost' docks the horse's colour name, and 'about' wraps the shuffle round what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: To conflict is to differ or clash in opinion, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: A politician supporting Conservative Party

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means placed below Conservative

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An MP backing the Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A faction or side in a dispute, as in the rival camps, is a party.

clue.text: Settler: mark a series about one

indicators.note: about means the mark and a series together go around the one

parts.note: a colon is a punctuation mark
a list is a series of items
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A settler annotating a list with a punctuation mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who settles in a colony, or who supports the colonial system, is a settler of new territory.

clue.text: Newcastle United nothing like entirely ready for Bucharest?

indicators.note: nothing like entirely says only part of the words is taken, a run straddling them

explanation.surface: Newcastle United are far from fully prepared for a trip to Romania.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ready' is slang for cash, as in readies; Bucharest is Romania's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Romania's currency unit is money there, and money is slang 'ready', hence cash for Bucharest.

clue.text: Old biker in government department

definitions.meaning: a 1960s British youth who rode a scooter, rivals of the rockers

explanation.surface: A retired motorcyclist working in a ministry.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1960s mods were a British youth subculture who rode Vespa and Lambretta scooters.
explanation.definitionFit: One word names both the scooter-riding sixties youth and the abbreviation for Britain's Ministry of Defence.

clue.text: Fat and happy, in summary

parts.note: round means plump or fat
up means cheerful, in good spirits

explanation.surface: A plump, jolly figure in short.
explanation.definitionFit: A news digest gathering the main points is a brief summary of them.

clue.text: Share hotel in state where one's lost?

indicators.note: in puts the hotel inside the dazed state

parts.note: a trance is a state in which one is lost to the surroundings
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Splitting a hotel stay in a place where you get lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a country or region, but it is a condition of mind.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion of money or securities released in stages is a share or slice of the whole.
